model_output.verdict: A construction project manager whose project values, schedules and change orders are easy to follow.
write_up: This is a strong construction project management resume! Your work at Capitol Builders connects project values and trade counts to results on schedule and change orders. A recruiter can quickly see the commercial work you manage.

The $14M grocery store line is the model: it names the build and says how it finished against schedule. Your move from assistant project manager to project manager is easy to follow, and your education sits in the right place below your experience.

Add a little more about how you kept change orders down, then leave the rest of this structure alone. Your resume isn't likely to be what holds you back; competition for a particular job will also matter.
